Dates and sources

Announced dates come from organiser listings. Regular schedules are calculated from published trading patterns, not individually confirmed. Sources are reviewed fortnightly and on request. Unconfirmed holiday dates and conflicting listings are withheld. Some hours and admission prices require checking with the organiser. Area filters describe parts of Greater London, not TfL fare zones. Images labelled as illustrations are category graphics, not photographs of the venue.
